description: This file defines the ModifierKeyState class, which manages the state of modifier keys (such as Shift, Ctrl, etc.) in an Android keyboard application. It handles physical and logical states, including press, release, lock, and active states, with support for double-click and long-press behaviors.

classes.name: ModifierKeyState
classes.description: Manages the state of a modifier key, including physical and logical states, with support for locking, double-click, and long-press behaviors.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Sets the physical state to pressing and records the press time.

methods.name: onOtherKeyPressed
methods.description: Handles the event when another key is pressed, updating the modifier's state accordingly.

methods.name: onOtherKeyReleased
methods.description: Handles the release of another key, updating the modifier's logical state if it was active and consumed.

methods.name: onRelease
methods.description: Handles the release of the modifier key, updating its logical state based on timing and support for locked state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the modifier key state to initial conditions.

methods.name: isPressed
methods.description: Returns true if the physical state is pressing.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns true if the modifier is active (either physically pressing or logically active).

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns true if the modifier is in a locked state.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the logical active state of the modifier, respecting locked state.

methods.name: toggleLocked
methods.description: Toggles the locked state of the modifier.
